title: [Advisory] GitLab CE/EE: Critical RCE in Regex Compiler (CVE-2026-97229)
content:
##### SEVERITY AND IMPACT:
- Successful exploitation allows unauthenticated network attackers to execute arbitrary code.
- **Current exploitation status**: UNKNOWN

##### AFFECTED PRODUCTS:
- GitLab Community Edition (CE)
- GitLab Enterprise Edition (EE)
- For specific versions, please check the references.

##### VULNERABILITY DETAILS:
- **Prerequisites:** Network access to an affected self-managed instance and delivery of a crafted regular expression through CI/CD configuration
- **Impact Details:** Arbitrary code executes on the GitLab server, enabling broad compromise of hosted projects and development infrastructure
- **Available Mitigations:**
  - Vendor patches are available; GitLab strongly recommends upgrading affected self-managed installations immediately

##### CVEs IN THIS ADVISORY:
- CVE-2026-97229 CVSS3.1: 10.0 (CRITICAL) - Integer overflow in the CI/CD regular-expression compiler enables unauthenticated remote code execution
 
##### Additional relevant CVEs fixed in the same release
- CVE-2026-92883 CVSS3.1: 8.7 (HIGH) - Crafted repositories can execute JavaScript in other users’ browser sessions
- CVE-2026-16301 CVSS3.1: 8.5 (HIGH) - Developers can execute downstream pipelines on protected branches without authorization
- CVE-2026-14814 CVSS3.1: 8.2 (HIGH) - Repository cache poisoning can expose protected variables through malicious pipeline content
- CVE-2026-81839 CVSS3.1: 7.7 (HIGH) - Stale policy records permit pipelines to execute with unintended group privileges
- CVE-2026-96893 CVSS3.1: 7.3 (HIGH) - Prompt injection can cause unintended commands attributed to other users

##### REFERENCES:

Primary:
- Source Advisory: https://docs.gitlab.com/releases/patches/patch-release-gitlab-19-4-2-released/ 

Supporting:
- News Coverage: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/gitlab-warns-of-max-severity-rce-flaw-in-regex-compiler-engine/ 

*Timestamp of the Information: 12.10.2026, 15:32*

**update 29.10.2026**
- **Current exploitation status**: Active exploitation
- Alpine Linux [reported exploitation attempts](https://alpinelinux.org/posts/GitLab-security-incident-CVE-2026-97229.html) of CVE-2026-97229 

CVE-2026-97229
summary: A critical integer overflow vulnerability in GitLab’s CI/CD regular-expression compiler can allow unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected servers. The flaw results from insufficient validation of specially crafted regular expressions in CI/CD configurations.
